title: Family RISE (Risk Information and Screening Education)
official: Refining and Testing Family RISE (Risk Information and Screening Education) for Children With Genetic Cancer Risk and Their Parents
summary: This study will evaluate the feasibility, acceptability, and impact of Family RISE on knowledge, psychological distress, and family communication about cancer risk and screening
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with an included cancer risk gene (Li-Fraumeni syndrome, pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma syndrome, DICER1, hereditary retinoblastoma, Familial Adenomatosis Polyposis, Von Hippel Lindau, Neurofibromatosis type 1, and Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome)
* English or Spanish-speaking and -reading
* Receiving care at study site or participating in Li-Fraumeni Syndrome Association (LFSA) Youth Conference

Exclusion Criteria:

* Parent/guardian or other family caregiver
* Participate in care of child under 18y with included cancer risk gene (Li-Fraumeni syndrome, pheochromocytoma-paraganglioma syndrome, DICER1, hereditary retinoblastoma, Familial Adenomatosis Polyposis, Von Hippel Lindau, Neurofibromatosis type 1, and Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome)
* English or Spanish-speaking and -reading
* At study site or participating in Li-Fraumeni Syndrome Association (LFSA)
